title: Contract Sunburst: Renewal Forecast & Next Steps (Q2 2026)
summary: Working spreadsheet that applies a sunburst-style heuristic to combine contract end dates, ARR concentration, customer health signals, and engagement cadence into a weighted renewal probability. Purpose: prioritize outreach and crystallize next-step owners for Q2 renewals. Template is intentionally opinionated (probability multipliers) so we can iterate during the cadence review.

calc_notes: Weighted Probability (%) = Base Probability * (0.6 + 0.04 * HealthScore) * engagement_multiplier. engagement_multiplier = clamp(1 + (14 - EngagementCadence)/100, 0.85, 1.2). Priority Tier mapping: High >65%, Medium 40-65%, Low <40%. ARR expressed as integer USD. Use Action By to schedule next play and roll into weekly renewal standup.
